capability.summary: Extract text from local HTML elements matching a CSS selector
capability.description: Reads one UTF-8 local HTML file with BeautifulSoup's html.parser, applies the supplied CSS selector, and returns stripped text for every matching element; direct wrapper invocation falls back to selector p only when the selector argument is omitted.
capability.problem_space: CSS-selector-driven plain-text extraction from elements in one static, file-backed HTML document.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: local HTML file path and CSS selector string; output: standard wrapper envelope containing stripped text for all matching elements.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8-readable local HTML file path
a CSS selector accepted by BeautifulSoup.select; direct wrapper invocation defaults an omitted selector to p although the manifest retains required=true
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.beautifulsoup_scrape", and matches as an array of stripped text strings in selector-match order. A caught file, decoding, parsing, or selector exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.beautifulsoup_scrape", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not fetch URLs or crawl websites
extracts only stripped element text and does not return attributes, markup, DOM nodes, or match locations
uses the built-in html.parser and fixed UTF-8 decoding with no caller-selectable parser or encoding
does not execute JavaScript or render dynamically generated page content
direct wrapper invocation defaults an omitted selector to p even though the manifest input contract declares selector required

output_contract.description: Standard JSON envelope containing stripped text from elements matching the supplied CSS selector in one local HTML file.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: extract text using a CSS selector from local HTML
collect stripped text from matching HTML elements
negative_intents: crawl or download a web page
